name: shortcutshelp-simple
description: IXT-SUITES batch 9 simple rung for the `shortcutsHelp` flag (pro tier — off in Simple). `?` opens the keyboard-shortcuts overlay (`useAppHotkeys.ts`) ONLY when the flag is on; with it off the same key falls back to toggling the Appearance panel (the old pre-flag behaviour), so the ladder proves the flag by observing which target reacts to the identical keypress in each mode: verifies shortcutsHelp is OFF in Simple, presses `?` and asserts the Appearance panel opens (NOT the shortcuts modal), closes it, switches to Pro + reresolves flags, verifies shortcutsHelp is ON, presses `?` again and asserts the `#shortcuts-help` modal opens with a populated `.kbd-grid`, then closes it with Escape and confirms it unmounts.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: shortcutsHelp should be OFF in Simple mode (it is pro-tier)

steps.name: assert-appearance-closed-baseline
steps.eval: (function(){ if (window.__store.getState().appearanceOpen) throw new Error('Expected appearanceOpen=false at baseline'); if (window.__store.getState().shortcutsHelpOpen) throw new Error('Expected shortcutsHelpOpen=false at baseline'); })()

steps.name: press-question-mark-simple
steps.eval: document.dispatchEvent && window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '?', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }))

steps.name: assert-appearance-opened-fallback
steps.failMessage: With shortcutsHelp OFF, `?` should fall back to toggling the Appearance panel

steps.name: assert-shortcuts-modal-still-closed
steps.eval: (function(){ if (window.__store.getState().shortcutsHelpOpen) throw new Error('shortcutsHelpOpen should stay false while the flag is off'); if (document.getElementById('shortcuts-help')) throw new Error('#shortcuts-help modal should not be mounted while the flag is off'); })()

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: shortcutsHelp should be ON once switched to Pro mode

steps.name: press-question-mark-pro
steps.eval: window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '?', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }))

steps.name: assert-shortcuts-modal-open
steps.failMessage: With shortcutsHelp ON in Pro, `?` should open the shortcuts overlay

steps.name: assert-kbd-grid-populated
steps.eval: (function(){ const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#shortcuts-help .kbd-row'); if (rows.length === 0) throw new Error('Expected populated .kbd-row entries inside the shortcuts modal'); })()

steps.name: assert-modal-closed
steps.failMessage: Escape should close the shortcuts modal
